# journey fixtures

- `docs-working-day.mmd`: the example from the Mermaid user journey
  documentation (https://mermaid.js.org/syntax/userJourney.html), MIT
  licensed, © Knut Sveidqvist and contributors.
- `my-day.mmd`: the mermaid-svg 0.7.0 sample
  (https://github.com/xmiksay/mermaid/tree/v0.7.0/samples), MIT licensed.
- `cjk-actors.mmd`, `minimal.mmd`: written for this crate: CJK, wrapping,
  every score level, several actors, a task without section or actors.
